prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, 1600x900 or larger (prefer 1792x1024 or exact 16:9). It must be a hand-drawn sports editorial illustration, never a photograph. No variants, no panels.
Style reference already inspected: approved B-culver-black-lime-v3. Match its very dark green-black #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, warm off-white, bold Japanese gothic headlines, rough ink contours, dry-brush hatching and one diagonal lime brush sweep. Do NOT copy its athlete, date, scores, name or headline.
Subject: exactly one REAL athlete, Anthony Clemmons (アンソニー・クレモンズ). Appearance reference: official B.LEAGUE 2026-27 profile at https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=51000280 and official portrait https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/745/2026-27/51000280_03.png, visually inspected. Preserve the actual face: dark brown skin, tightly braided black cornrows running backward with narrow center parting and close sides, slightly receding temples, broad forehead, thick low eyebrows, deep brown eyes, medium broad nose with rounded nostrils, full lips, defined cheekbones and a connected full black beard and moustache, beard a little longer below the chin. Strong lean guard physique. Render the individual in expressive ink and cream shadow planes, not a generic invented athlete.
Scene is a conceptual basketball play illustration, NOT a depiction of any actual match. Show a dynamic low dribble drive, three-quarter view facing slightly left, head up, torso leaning forward, right hand controlling the basketball at knee/hip level and left arm bent naturally for balance. Anatomically correct wrists, five natural fingers per visible hand, two arms, and correct ball interaction. Head, both hands and ball fully inside image margins. Athlete on the RIGHT 43%, figure cropped intentionally below mid thighs. Orange basketball is a hand-controlled prop. No other people.
Plain off-white sleeveless basketball jersey and shorts, no logos, no league marks, no sponsor names, no brand marks, no player name, no jersey number. Some subtle tattoos may be hinted only as abstract ink shading.
Composition: LEFT 55% has exceptionally clean typographic negative space, no figure or brush across text. Background mostly dark. One broad lime diagonal brush behind the figure with sparse ink flecks, keep few elements and strong mobile readability. 5% safe margins.
Render ONLY the following exact Japanese text, with precise spelling and no extra text:
Top-left small branding: 「バスケまとめ」
Above main headline, medium lime: 「11/27 B.ONE」
Main headline, very large warm-white heavy bold: 「試合結果」
Immediately below headline, prominent lime box with black bold lettering, all on one readable line: 「公式記録の確定待ち」
Below that, smaller but legible white: 「2026.11.27 19:05 JST 時点」
Bottom-left, readable white annotation with comfortable margins: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Beside that annotation, white: 「イメージ」
The pending qualifier must be prominent, not tiny. Fullwidth parentheses in （AI生成）. Do not write Clemmons's name or his statistics, participation, achievements, match result, score, victory, TOP3 or best-five claims anywhere. The source manuscript is pending official records as of 2026-11-27 19:05 JST. Do not imply the image recreates an actual game moment. Text must be exactly as specified. No official photo pixels or photographic collage.
prompt.revision:
Edit this exact thumbnail with one targeted layout correction only. Preserve every existing Japanese text glyph and number, the black/lime palette, rough ink style, and the same real Anthony Clemmons likeness, cornrows, beard, white unbranded uniform and dribbling pose.
The basketball is clipped by the bottom edge and the head and right elbow are too close to the frame edges. Reduce the entire athlete-and-ball illustration as one coherent unit to about 84% of its current size, positioned entirely in the right-hand portion, so there is at least 5% canvas margin above the head, to the right of the elbow, and below the WHOLE basketball. Keep the same body and hands, no extra limbs. Both hands and all five fingers on each hand must remain correct and fully visible. The figure may still be intentionally cropped below the thighs, but the basketball, head, hands and elbows must be completely visible. Keep the ball as the player's controlled dribbling prop.
Do not change, reword, add or remove ANY existing typography: バスケまとめ / 11/27 B.ONE / 試合結果 / 公式記録の確定待ち / 2026.11.27 19:05 JST 時点 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ.
Keep all left-column text fully clear with no overlap. Preserve 16:9 landscape at least 1600px wide. No logos, jersey numbers, additional text, photographs or new people. This is an image illustration, never a reconstruction of an actual match.
